hooks.command: cd /Users/chris/Code/waifu-rt3d && echo '--- Session Context ---' && head -20 CURRENT_STATUS.md 2>/dev/null && echo '--- Last Handoff ---' && head -10 docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md 2>/dev/null || echo 'No handoff file'
hooks.description: Auto-inject project status at session start for instant orientation

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(\.env"|app\.db"|credentials|\.local\.json")' && echo 'BLOCKED: Sensitive file — confirm with user before editing .env, app.db, credentials, or .local.json files' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
hooks.description: Block edits to sensitive files (.env, app.db, credentials, .local.json)

hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '_BACKUP_ROOT' && echo 'BLOCKED: _BACKUP_ROOT is sacred — read-only archive. Never modify, delete, or move files inside it.' >&2 && exit 2 || exit 0
hooks.description: Hard-block any write operation targeting _BACKUP_ROOT directory

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILES; do if [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then /opt/homebrew/bin/ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null; .venv/bin/python -m py_compile "$f" || echo "SYNTAX ERROR in $f"; fi; done
hooks.description: Auto-lint with Ruff + syntax check after every Python edit

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILES; do if [[ "$f" == *.ts || "$f" == *.tsx ]]; then cd frontends/sakura && npx tsc --project tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | tail -20; break; fi; done
hooks.description: Auto-check TypeScript types after every edit

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILES; do if [[ "$f" == *.ts || "$f" == *.tsx ]]; then cd frontends/sakura && npx @biomejs/biome check --write "../../$f" 2>/dev/null; fi; done
hooks.description: Auto-format + safe-autofix TypeScript files with Biome (format + lint) after edit

hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "Task complete — check Claude Code" with title "Waifu-RT3D" sound name "Glass"' 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.description: macOS desktop notification when Claude finishes responding
